caption.en: Figure 35.1 — Two paths from the same preference pair to a changed policy.
caption.zh-hans: 图 35.1：同一组偏好对，可以沿两条路径改变策略。

alt.en: The reward-model route first fits scores from chosen/rejected labels, then uses sampled response scores and a fixed reference to update the policy. DPO instead compares four response probabilities and updates only the policy against the fixed reference.
alt.zh-hans: 奖励模型路径先用偏好标签拟合分数，再用采样回答的分数和固定参考策略更新策略。DPO 直接比较四个回答概率，相对固定参考策略更新当前策略。

label.zh-hans: 奖励模型 → RL 策略更新

text.en: Pair A > B → fit reward scores
text.zh-hans: 偏好 A > B → 拟合奖励分数

text.en: Reward model: trained first, fixed in this RL stage
text.zh-hans: 奖励模型：先训练，在本次 RL 阶段固定

text.en: Sample policy outputs → reward − β log ratio
text.zh-hans: 采样策略输出 → 奖励 − β 对数比
更新策略；参考策略保持固定

flow.en: Comparison labels and sampled actions have different jobs. The expected log ratio supplies the KL penalty.
flow.zh-hans: 比较标签与采样动作承担不同作用；对数比的期望形成 KL 惩罚。

text.en: Same prompt, chosen A, rejected B

text.zh-hans: 由偏好对损失更新策略

flow.en: No standalone reward-model fit or on-policy rollout inside this update; labels and reference probabilities are still required.
flow.zh-hans: 本次更新不单独拟合奖励模型，也不从当前策略采样；仍需要标签与参考概率。
